manualDailyWalk.title: Daily steps — manual entry
manualDailyWalk.subtitle: For days without your watch (charging, forgot…), log phone step totals. Garmin is the primary source: manual steps only count when the watch has no data that day. Declared steps earn half the XP rate (0.0021 vs 0.0042 for Garmin), capped at 100 XP/day.

disciplineCalendar.recapHint: Averages = period total ÷ number of calendar days (week = Mon–Sun, month = civil month, year = the year shown under the calendar). The “active days” line divides by days with at least one session.
disciplineCalendar.intensityHint: Intensity = number of sessions logged that day (selected year).
disciplineCalendar.detailPlaceholder: Click a day to see details
disciplineCalendar.runningSustainedHint: Workouts flagged as intervals (type or Garmin effort/recovery laps) are excluded. We pick the fastest average pace (min/km), then the longest duration among blocks within ±0.25 min/km. Garmin blocks = consecutive laps without warmup, recovery, or cooldown.
disciplineCalendar.runningSustainedNone: Not enough data (or only interval work).
disciplineCalendar.runningIntervalHint: Interval sessions only. Score = (effort speed + 0.38 × recovery speed) × (1 + effort lap count)^0.42 (km/h; laps = effort/rep laps from Garmin). Without detailed lap splits this card stays empty.
disciplineCalendar.runningIntervalNone: No interval session with usable lap splits.

gtg.title: Challenges · Grease the Groove
gtg.subtitle: Easy mini-sets spread through the day — neural strength without muscle fatigue.
gtg.methodP1: Instead of one big session, do several easy sets (~40–60% of your max) without going to failure. Repeat quality movement often.
gtg.methodP2: Example: 4–8 mini-sets per day per exercise, spaced through the day. Each set should feel easy — you could do much more.
gtg.methodP3: When reps feel trivial for several days, add one rep (same logic for pull-ups, dips and push-ups). 5–6 days per week is enough.
gtg.methodOptional: This is optional: great for pull-ups/dips/push-ups alongside running, but nothing forces you to do it every day.
gtg.xpExplain: Modest XP per rep (~{{perRep}}) + tier bonuses: +{{bonus50}} XP at 50% of today's plan, +{{bonus100}} XP when complete (daily cap anti-abuse).
gtg.performanceMaxHint: Suggested (Performances / history): {{max}} rep max — editable, not required.
gtg.slotsHint: 4–8 slots/day is ideal; beyond 12, recovery rarely keeps up.
gtg.scheduleHint: Check off each mini-set when done — easy, no grinding.
gtg.noExercises: Select at least one exercise above.
gtg.repsSyncHint: Checked mini-sets also feed your rep journal (Today) and the Recap 3D model.
gtg.clickToConfigure: Click an exercise to edit its times, reps and frequency (each exercise can have its own rhythm).
